parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the OceanBase cluster. The name must be 1 to 20 characters long and can contain English or Chinese characters. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the instance ID of the cluster.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

- Starts from 1.

- Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Maximum value: 100.

- Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the API returns instances from all resource groups.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search on the instance ID, instance name, tenant ID, and tenant name.
